# How pool leak detection works in Fair Play, SC

Aquatrace uses a structured inspection process so pool owners can separate normal evaporation from actual water loss.

A recent completed job in Fair Play, SC followed the same evidence-first workflow: confirm reported loss, inspect structure and plumbing systems, document findings, and leave the owner with a clear next step.

Work completed included Leak isolation at Fair Play, SC.

For pool owners in Serving Western North Carolina and Upstate South Carolina., the useful lesson is simple: measure daily loss, compare it against evaporation, and get a professional test when the numbers do not line up.
